notes: Gen Z (no AI use) matches the non-AI student scenario directly and stores the phone-versus-laptop split used in Section 3.
Gen Z (moderate AI use) uses the scenario's prompt, image, media, and Zoom quantities, then stores a laptop browsing bundle because the calculator still treats homework and browsing as one row.
Gen Z (vibe coder) uses the scenario's actual quantities, including 8 high-reasoning prompts, and stores the scenario's phone, laptop, and coding-agent device context for future UI use.
Worker (hosts Zoom meetings) stores TV Netflix, phone Instagram, laptop browsing, and the hosted-meeting device bundle even though the live row remains fixed.
summary: The presets use the four Section 3 scenarios as their names and activity patterns, and now also apply the intended device context in the live device-aware streaming rows.
